_readme: This is the ONLY file you need to edit to change the website. Ask Claude to update it for you. Everything below shows up on the page.

site.headline: Come see the work up close
site.intro: We're hosting a handful of small-group visits this October and November. Each one is a different window into what your support makes possible. Take a look, then tell us which one you'd like to join — we'll follow up with details and confirm your spot.
site.closingNote: Questions? Reply to the email that brought you here, or reach out to Rebecca directly.

form._endpointHelp: Paste your Google Apps Script Web App URL here once you've deployed it (see apps-script/SETUP.md). Until then the form shows a friendly 'not open yet' message instead of failing.
form.notesLabel: Anything we should know? (dietary needs, accessibility, questions)
form.successBody: Rebecca will be in touch within a few days to confirm your spot and share the details.
